assumptions.text: Canonical URL for 'latest visible month' is calendarMonth absent. A stale/invalid/out-of-range calendarMonth is canonicalized by exactly one setCalendarMonth(null) with history replace; the effect depends on the stale value only, so after the write the month is null and the effect cannot refire.

calendarMonth parser is a plain nullable string parser (no default). Shape and range are validated together by membership in listCalendarMonths(calendar.displayRange), which only yields yyyy-MM (statistics-calendar.ts:102-113); malformed values ('2026-13', '2026-3', 'abc') fail membership.

Canonicalization lives in ReadingCalendarCard (mounted in both modes), not in ReadingBooksCalendar, so a stale month is cleaned in activity mode too. Radix Tabs.Content unmounts inactive panels (page-tabs.tsx:86), so nothing runs off the activity tab.

Server range historyQuality is legacy iff from < reliableFrom (activity-history-quality.ts:9-17); a calendar day is legacy iff date < reliableFrom (activity-history-quality.ts:37-45); days[] is dense over displayRange (reading-calendar.ts:45). So 'any day in the clipped month has historyQuality legacy_observed_only' is the client-side equivalent of the server historyQuality for that month. It drives the books lower-bound marker on the no-fetch path ('complete previews and legacy days coexist', spec L17). Active days / pages markers keep the shipped hasUnknownDays rule.
New hook file apps/web/src/features/statistics/api/use-reading-month-books.ts; query key literally ['/api/statistics/reading-month-summary', from, to] (spec L16).

Habits description shows the metricRange label (schema: 'metricRange is what the summary numbers describe', reading-statistics-calendar.ts:110). The calendar card keeps its current description and displayRange/legacy notes unchanged.

P3 slot is an optional ReactNode prop on ReadingDynamicsCard rendered only for variant 'full'. Selection is an inline filter of overview.overviewInsights[view.metric] to the two *_vs_comparison codes; no new model helper.
